title: ARCHER: From Rationale Imitation to Executable Reasoning in Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18494v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small language models are attractive for local, low-cost, and privacy-sensitive deployment, but they remain unreliable on mathematical reasoning tasks that require decomposition, exact computation, tool use, and verification. We introduce \textbf{ARCHER}: \textbf{A}ction-trace \textbf{R}einforcement for \textbf{C}alculator-grounded \textbf{H}ierarchical \textbf{E}xecutable \textbf{R}easoning, a two-stage framework for training small language models (SLMs) to produce executable and auditable reasoning trajectories. In the first stage, ARCHER compiles free-form chain-of-thought rationales into typed action traces containing reasoning steps, calculator calls, deterministic runtime observations, verification actions, and final answers. This shifts the supervision target from imitating explanatory text to learning a tool-grounded reasoning policy. translated_title: ARCHER：小型语言模型从推理依据模仿到可执行推理
translated_abstract: 小型语言模型因其适合本地、低成本和隐私敏感的部署场景而具有吸引力，但在需要任务分解、精确计算、工具使用和验证的数学推理任务上仍然不可靠。我们提出了ARCHER（Action-trace Reinforcement for Calculator-grounded Hierarchical Executable Reasoning，基于计算器的分层可执行推理的动作轨迹强化），这是一个用于训练小型语言模型（SLM）生成可执行且可审计推理轨迹的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，ARCHER将自由格式的思维链推理依据编译为类型化的动作轨迹，其中包含推理步骤、计算器调用、确定性运行时观测、验证动作和最终答案。这将监督目标从模仿解释性文本转变为学习一种基于工具的推理策略。在第二阶段，ARCHER通过非对称分层强化学习对这一策略进行进一步优化（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: ARCHER提出两阶段训练框架，先将自由格式的思维链编译为包含计算器调用与验证的类型化动作轨迹，再通过非对称分层强化学习优化策略，使小型语言模型学会生成可执行、可审计的数学推理轨迹。
en_tdlr: ARCHER is a two-stage framework that compiles free-form chain-of-thought rationales into typed, calculator-grounded action traces and refines them via asymmetric hierarchical reinforcement learning, enabling small language models to produce executable and auditable mathematical reasoning trajectories.
